items.title: 多智能体协同重构医疗AI！清华AIR孵化：医生AI分身“坐诊”医院

extra.evidence: 医疗AI质变时刻 哪里不舒服、持续了多久，还包括既往病史，这些零零碎碎的信息，都在预问诊阶段准备妥帖。 走进去更科幻更未来的是，这里的每个医生都能拥有辅助自己工作的专属AI分身，但这还远远不够。 围绕这个问题，紫荆智康此次带来了医学领域的 多分身智能体协同技术 （Multidisciplinary Human-Agent Collaboration），并进一步升级“紫荆AI医院”（Agent Hospital）。 AI医院里，AI医生与人类医生通力合作…… 一个连接真实诊疗、能够持续进化的虚拟医疗世界 ，正逐渐成形。 先挂内科，查不出所以然转外科，外科看完再约影像科，几个科室的号都挂遍了，才轮得上发起一次正式的 多学科会诊 （MDT）。 紫荆智康的思路比较直接，既然让患者去找专家不太现实，那不如 先让专家分身集体到位 。 反之如果是那些跨学科的复杂问题，紫荆智康则干脆给这些分身搭了个 多学科协作会议 。 当具备不同专长的Agent分身依次加入分析，单一医生能获得的专业视角直接被大幅度拓宽。 举个例子，现在有位因甲亢进入内分泌科的患者，在问诊过程中，系统同步收集到患者还兼有哮喘病史的信息。 这就是多分身智能体协同的基本逻辑，它能够 把跨专科支持前置 到首诊、预问诊这些更早的环节。 换句话说，患者走进这间诊室时，就有一整个医生团队在打辅助，那些疑难重症专属的多学科支持就有可能成为日常诊疗的标配。 医生还是照常进行门诊，随着患者不断提供新信息，系统识别其它专科参与的需要，再把相关分身的意见以提醒方式呈现给医生。 对于已经明确需要多个专科共同分析的病例，多个分身直接参与其中，并在界面上围绕诊断、用药等环节呈现对应建议。 系统会分别呈现不同分身的建议， 对不一致之处高亮提醒 。医生能够看到意见来自哪个分身，再结合患者情况、相关依据及自己的经验，完成最终判断。 对比其它医疗Agent…

items.title: LeCun押注的世界模型，中国一家清华系公司已经做进了机器人
items.summary: 世界模型赛道新看点：千诀隐变量可辨识性方向的研究，比LeCun相近工作早一年，不堆画面预测，主打物理规律与跨本体复用。

extra.evidence: 世界模型赛道新看点：千诀隐变量可辨识性方向的研究，比LeCun相近工作早一年，不堆画面预测，主打物理规律与跨本体复用。 Yann LeCun持续押注预测式世界模型，李飞飞带领World Labs探索可交互的3D世界，全球头部AI团队正沿着不同技术路线加速探索。 10月20日， 首届2026物理AI与世界模型大会 在南京开幕。图灵奖得主 LeCun、姚期智 都远程分享了最新观察。 在这场世界模型领域的学术与产业盛会上，清华系具身智能公司 千诀科技 ，也在大会上正式发布了 预测式世界模型Polibrain 。 而千诀此次发布的Polibrain，想做的就是让机器人拥有这样一张可以用于预测和规划的「地图」。 早在2025年，千诀联合清华大学团队就在ICML发表了世界模型相关理论研究，其在隐变量可辨识性、低阶偏好等方向上的公开探索， 比LeCun团队的相近研究早了约一年。 从环境感知、行动预测，到自主规划和执行反馈，千诀试图让机器人学会根据物理世界的变化，自主决定下一步怎么做。 千诀的预测式世界模型Polibrain，究竟有什么特别之处？他们又是如何让不同形态的机器人，共用一套智能大脑的？ 随后，他讲了一个「古代商人从广州运送荔枝到长安，怎样才能找到最快的路线？」的故事。 另一种方法，则是先弄清广州到长安沿途有哪些城市、城市之间如何连接，画出一张地图，再根据地图规划路线。 它需要自主寻找地面上的垃圾，识别目标位置，移动过去，再规划机械臂动作，将垃圾抓起来，放进随身携带的回收筐。 看起来只是一套捡垃圾的动作，背后却有一连串决策难题： 垃圾在哪里？机器狗应该从哪个方向靠近？机械臂伸出去之后，能不能顺利抓住目标？ 尤其是在真实环境中，物体的位置、空间关系都可能发生变化。机器人光知道下一步做什么还不够，还得提前判断，这一步做下去会发生什么。 Polibrain通过学习环境状态、历史信息和…

items.title: S-Agent 2.0: Spatial Reasoning with a General Coding Agent
items.summary: Spatial reasoning asks a model to work out where objects are in 3D space, how they relate to one another, and how they move. Agentic VLMs have recently brought large improvements on such tasks by letting the model actively gather evidence with 3D perception tools instead of answering in a single pass. Even so, on many questions the tools return the right evidence and the model still does not arrive at the correct answer: the gap between model and tools, where raw readings become usable conclusions, is left unfilled. We present S-Agent 2.0, a spatial reasoning agent that equips an off-the-shelf general coding agent with a command-line perception toolkit, and we design the interface around one principle: help the VLM close the evidence loop: acquire scene evidence, remember it in a persistent scene memory, and interpret each reading in plain spatial language. This design keeps the full flexibility of a coding agent, and every reading it acts on stays grounded in the tools' geometry. On MMSI-Bench and ReVSI, the toolkit improves a strong open-source model, Qwen3.8-27B, by +13.9 and +20.5 points over the same agent without tools, and a strong closed-source model, Gemini-3.8-Flash, by +11.2 and +9.6 points. With the open backbone S-Agent 2.0 reaches 66.5 on MMSI-Bench and 82.3 on ReVSI, ahead of the specialized system SpatialClaw on the same backbone (62.6 and 74.5), and with Gemini-3.8-Flash it reaches 74.1 and 90.5 against its 67.0 and 79.7. Both tool gains shrink as the backbo…

items.title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
items.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains. Such tasks demand grounded perception, external knowledge, and numerical measurements obtained through heterogeneous tools, whose outputs must be made interpretable to the model and retained across reasoning steps. We introduce OpenVLHarness, a multimodal reasoning harness organized around a capability layer and persistent multimodal memory. The capability layer combines task-level tool interfaces with evidence rendering, providing consistent access to heterogeneous backends and converting their outputs into model-readable observations. Persistent multimodal memory retains the corresponding images, structured data, and web references as addressable artifacts throughout each query. A coding interface executes generated programs over stored data, enabling computations that combine results from multiple tools. Together, these mechanisms support an iterative process of acquiring, inspecting, and composing multimodal evidence. Evaluated on 22 benchmarks with eight open and proprietary backbones, OpenVLHarness improves average scores by 9.7-12.6 points over matched no-tool baselines, including +11.2 with Qwen3-VL-8B, +9.7 with Kimi K3, and +9.9 with GPT-6 Astra. With GPT-6…

items.title: DeclineCraft: A RAG Abstention Benchmark for Jointly Measuring Combined Retrieval and Parametric Knowledge
items.summary: Reliable retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) requires recognizing when neither retrieved documents nor parametric knowledge supports an answer. We introduce DeclineCraft, a dynamic abstention benchmark whose unanswerable questions target Minecraft feature additions after a corpus cut-off, with audits of possible parametric exposure. Later cut-offs support evaluation of future models. Across 27 LLMs, we measure Correct Abstention Rate (CAR; how often models acknowledge insufficient knowledge on unanswerable questions), Answerable Attempt Rate and Answer Accuracy. We find that (1) single-shot retrieval significantly raises CAR in 38 of 40 configurations (model and thinking setting) versus no retrieval. (2) Iterative RAG, in which the model self-assesses its context and can request up to two further retrieval rounds, significantly lowers CAR versus single-shot RAG in 30 of 40 configurations (mean 46.4%), with little change in Answer Accuracy (68.5% to 69.3%). Adding query rewriting and reranking to hybrid (dense & sparse) retrieval lowers CAR for all 12 models tested. (3) Larger models answer more accurately (Spearman $ρ= +0.60$ with total parameters), but neither model size nor release date shows a significant association with CAR. (4) Without retrieval, enabling thinking on the same weights lowers CAR significantly for 8 of 13 models (by 14% points on average), and the responses shift from acknowledged uncertainty to premise denial.

items.summary_zh: 为了评估检索增强生成（RAG）模型在无法回答问题时的拒绝能力，DeclineCraft 构建了一个包含 Minecraft 功能更新的动态基准。实验发现，单次检索能显著提高正确拒绝率，而迭代 RAG 和混合检索策略则可能降低该指标。

items.title: Beyond the Point Mass: Acceptance-Derived Weights and Distributional Losses for Speculative Decoding
items.summary: In speculative decoding, a lightweight draft model proposes tokens that the target model verifies in parallel, speeding up generation without changing the target distribution. D-PACE (Wu et al., 2026) trains such drafters with a loss that weights each position by its contribution to the expected accepted length. Both its weights and its cross-entropy (CE) loss use only the draft's probability of the recorded target token, treating the target as a point mass. Under rejection sampling, however, a sampled draft token is accepted with probability equal to the overlap of the draft and target distributions, one minus their total variation (TV). We derive D-PAL (Dynamic Position-wise Acceptance Loss) from the exact expected accepted length, using this overlap as the acceptance signal. This yields overlap-based position weights with log acceptance (LA) as the per-position loss, and the objective reduces to D-PACE for a point-mass target. Since the weights are detached, any per-position loss can replace LA in practice. We show that forward KL divergence and Rényi divergence of order 1/2 match or exceed LA, and that Rényi-1/2 provably bounds the true acceptance rate from above and below. Replacing CE with Rényi-1/2 improves acceptance length under both D-PACE's weights and ours. On six benchmarks with a Qwen3-4B target, D-PAL raises mean acceptance length over D-PACE from 4.50 to 4.57 at T=0 and from 4.20 to 4.28 at T=1, and consistently achieves higher throughput at both temperatures.
items.title_zh: 超越点质量：基于接受度的权重与分布损失用于推测解码
items.summary_zh: 针对推测解码中目标模型被视为点质量的问题，D-PAL 方法利用重叠概率作为接受信号来计算动态位置权重。实验表明，使用 Rényi-1/2 散度替代交叉熵损失，能在多个基准测试中提高接受长度并保持更高的吞吐量。

items.title: KEEP-Bench: Evaluating Evidence Preservation in Context Compression
items.summary: Context compression improves long-context efficiency but may introduce faithfulness issues through an information bottleneck. Existing evaluations rely on QA metrics, but a reader can still answer correctly from an unfaithful compression, so these metrics underestimate such loss. To bridge this gap, we introduce KEEP-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that directly assesses compression faithfulness with 4,102 cases across three challenging settings that require keeping evidence for plausible reference resolutions, explicit qualifiers, and minority perspectives. Experiments show that even with tailored prompting, the strongest models remain unreliable: despite context windows exceeding 100K tokens and inputs averaging only 3.1K tokens, the best open-weight model (31B) preserves all required evidence in only 66.8% of cases, and the best proprietary model in only 61.6%. Performance also varies sharply across evidence structures, so conclusions from limited structures may be biased. We further introduce a metric, Evidence Preservation Return (EPR), to relate evidence recall to inference FLOPs, and find that it peaks at moderate scales (4B-8B), where recall remains low. Additional output budget mainly benefits already strong models and widens capability gaps, yet the stronger preservation of these models comes at a steep computational cost. These findings highlight the importance for future work to investigate compressors with strong information preservation under a small computation…
